scope: Actual UI verification and fixes; Vercel excluded

coverage.warning: Initial viewport screenshots are not complete page/interaction acceptance. Mirrored source routes can differ from generated published artifacts; source-only differences are not counted as confirmed production bugs.

findings.title: Review score overlaps slider hit target by 10.59375px
findings.root_cause: Fixed 40px/32px grid rows cannot contain a 55.2px number and 48px slider
findings.test: Existing quick-rate browser test:320/390/1348px geometry, Chromium and WebKit; captures screenshots

findings.title: Rating ranking audience scores show dash despite source score
findings.root_cause: Renderer mounts shared review with only id and title; source score and vote count dropped
findings.test: Existing ranking/calendar browser test through real ranking renderer; 8.4 score becomes4.2

findings.title: Light-theme ranking title and metadata unreadable against fixed dark wrapper
findings.root_cause: Theme sets dark text, integrated ranking wrapper fixes dark background
findings.test: Existing ranking/calendar browser test: title and metadata contrast >=4.5 in both themes

findings.title: My Cinelva summary heading and supporting text invisible or too pale in light theme
findings.root_cause: Legacy dark variables on body shadow light theme root variables and summary forces white text
findings.test: Existing mobile layout browser test: summary heading, hero, utilities and count captions contrast >=4.5 in both themes

findings.title: Related12 and director6 movie cards on movie detail have no shared review or bookmarks and show a separate10-point score
findings.root_cause: Detail galleries render isolated buttons instead of shared movie actions
findings.test: Existing record-entry browser journey: related/director links, review identity, independent bookmark,5-point score,3 columns and mobile overflow in Chromium/WebKit

findings.title: Original release date caption still uses公開日 instead of requested公開年月日
findings.root_cause: Shared date caption helper retains old text
findings.test: Full date caption regression first failed with公開日 then passed with公開年月日; event captions preserved

findings.title: Light-theme calendar/source/legal header logo and wordmark fade against page background
findings.root_cause: Calendar-specific important transparent image background overrides common backing; legacy gLogo/wordmark missed shared theme selector
findings.test: Existing route screenshots after shared CSS selector repair; approved image asset unchanged

remaining_audit: Complete interaction, error/empty states, scroll and lower page content checks for active routes; do not equate 30 initial screenshots or CI success with bug-free UI.
